name: Peanut Butter Cookies
assumptions: Yield estimated from standard 3-ingredient PB cookie recipes using 1 cup PB + 1 egg, which reliably produce 10-14 cookies; conservatively using 12 servings of 1 cookie each.
Preparation time is estimated as 15 minutes active (mixing, scooping, forking) plus 8-10 minutes bake time, totaling 25 minutes; no chilling or other steps indicated.
Peanut butter classified as containing peanuts (true) but ambiguous for tree nuts or soy (null) due to possible cross-contact or additives in unspecified brands.
Sugar and baking sheet assumed free of animal products for vegetarian/pescatarian compatibility.
No wheat, milk, fish, shellfish, or sesame ingredients listed or implied.
instructions:
Preheat oven to 350ºF (180ºC).
In a large bowl, mix together the peanut butter, sugar, and egg.
Scoop out a spoonful of dough and roll it into a ball. Place the cookie balls onto a nonstick baking sheet.
For extra decoration and to make them cook more evenly, flatten the cookie balls by pressing a fork down on top of them, then press it down again at a 90º angle to make a criss-cross pattern.
Bake for 8-10 minutes or until the bottom of the cookies are golden brown.
Remove from baking sheet and cool.
Enjoy!

ingredients.name: Peanut Butter
ingredients.assumptions: Standard creamy peanut butter; 1 cup ≈ 250 g; values for unsweetened natural style common in recipes.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Granulated white sugar; 1/2 cup ≈ 100 g; essentially pure sucrose.

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.assumptions: Large whole egg; 1 large ≈ 50 g edible portion (without shell).
